 "data": "classDiagram
 class Backend {
 +currentState State
 +songStart time.Time
 +songDuration float64
 +voteYes int
 +voteNo int
 +setState(s State)
 +analyzeAudio(path string) map
 +callOllama(prompt, model) string

 +getCandidates(db, file, mood) list
 }
 
 class AudioMetadata {
 +filepath string
 +title string
 +artist string
 +duration float64
 +bpm float64
 +energy float64
 +mood_label string

 }
 
 class DirectorAgent {
 +model string
 +selectNextTrack(candidates, history) Song
 }
 
 class DJAgent {
 +model string
 +generateIntro(currentSong, nextSong) string
 }
 
 class ChatterboxTTS {
 +model string
 +synthesize(text) wav_path
 }
 
 class Librarian {
 +analyzeAudio(path) AudioMetadata
 +extractBPM() float
 +extractMood() string
 }

 Backend --> DJAgent
 Backend --> ChatterboxTTS
 Backend --> Librarian",
